mutations.name: the-digest-sees-only-head
mutations._mechanism: The HEAD-only comparison this row replaces: an uncommitted edit under a run is invisible, which is every recorded case (2026-08-25, 2026-09-07 twice).

mutations.name: the-session-never-reports
mutations._mechanism: The digest is taken and compared but the line is never printed: the pass count above it still describes bytes that no longer exist, silently.

mutations.name: run-churn-is-reported-as-a-moved-tree
mutations._mechanism: pytest's cache and the harness's bytecode purge are written by the run itself; a repo that does not ignore them would see every run as moved, and a report that always fires is read as noise.
mutations.find: if not rel or any(part in _DIGEST_SKIP_PARTS for part in Path(rel).parts):

mutations.name: the-harness-compares-head-only
mutations._mechanism: The harness kept its HEAD comparison and dropped the digest: a sibling's unstaged write during a mutation run scores as a clean verdict (2026-09-07: a false REFUSED anchor).

mutations.name: hmad-bookkeeping-moves-the-tree
mutations._mechanism: Review S5: HemaSuite tracks `.h-mad/telemetry.jsonl`; a live lane's telemetry row during a multi-minute run would void a verdict about code it never touched.

mutations.name: done-markers-move-the-tree
mutations._mechanism: Review S5: HemaSuite does not ignore `*.done`; an audit-completion marker written by a live lane is bookkeeping, not a change to measured code.

mutations.name: run-suite-drops-tree-moved
mutations._mechanism: Review S7: the gate certified a cycle's suite as PASS while the session itself had said the tree moved under it.

mutations.name: the-suite-line-drops-tree-moved
mutations._mechanism: Review S7: the measured fact reached the outcome but not the SUITE line the cycle driver prints, which is the line that certifies the cycle.
mutations.find: moved = f" tree_moved={outcome['tree_moved']}" if outcome.get("tree_moved") else ""

mutations.name: the-whole-hmad-dir-is-skipped
mutations._mechanism: R2-S1: skipping every .h-mad/ entry hides an edit to a TRACKED file the suite reads (invariants.md, wires.jsonl), so the session prints no TREE_MOVED for bytes it measured.
mutations.find:
if ".h-mad" not in parts:
        return False

mutations.name: a-colored-tree-moved-line-is-dropped
mutations._mechanism: R2-N3: under --color=yes the plugin's yellow line starts with an SGR escape and a `^SUITE:` match misses it, so the gate certifies the cycle without tree_moved.
